name: schedulebar
description: Capture Codex commitments and explicit task requests into ScheduleBar.

interface.shortDescription: Record Codex tasks into the local ScheduleBar app
interface.longDescription: ScheduleBar plugin ships Codex lifecycle hooks plus MCP tools that append explicit record-as-task events to a durable local queue. Ordinary Chat/Work is not captured automatically; those sessions must use the record_as_task tool or `schedulebar-mcp record`. It does not modify user-level Codex hooks and does not monitor clipboard, browser, or Accessibility APIs.
defaultPrompt: Record this as a task: file the weekly report on Friday.
